summary: MGP Ingredients filed an 8-K reporting Amendment No. 2 to its credit agreement and an Eighth Amendment to its note purchase agreement, both dated August 6, 2026. The amendments modify the Consolidated EBITDA definition to allow add-backs of up to $20 million of losses from specific customer receivables through December 31, 2027. The company also exercised an option to increase its net leverage covenant to 4.50x for four fiscal quarters due to earnout obligations from the Penelope Bourbon acquisition. The filing describes precautionary covenant-relief measures, not a special situation; no M&A, tender, or other event category applies.
